baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: Take a trip down memory lane in this Installment of Call of Duty: World at War – Zombies. This map is inspired by the Original Tutorial world from the Console editions of Minecraft. Everything is Minecraft-ified, including weapon textures, zombie models, and the main quest itself. Discover the plethora of new weapons, perks and traps that can aid you in slaughtering the Undead hordes. The map started out as a total meme back in April of 2024, but quickly derailed in a scripting nightmare, with countless attempts at making the main quest work. I hope you enjoy! Features included: – Custom Box Locator – Bo1 weapons – Bo1 Perks (bo1 QR, DT 2.0) – Full Easter Egg Quest – Custom Easter Egg Song – Buyable ending – Bandolier Perk & Electric Cherry – Dive to Prone PHD – Custom Pickaxe Weapon – Minecraft Parody Music Box Credits: Vertasea & YaF3li – Cod WaW Mod Tool Definitive Edition (which includes many of the prefabs, anims, models, and others used), countless hours of scripting and mapping help, being general homies. Literally every other day I was bothering one of these two for scripting help, so this wouldn’t have happened without either of them. Quizz – Texture help with the PaPed weapon textures.
